name: forthclear
description: Search surplus and overstock liquidation inventory, request bulk quotes, and check out — or, as a seller, list pallets and answer quotes — through ForthClear's hosted MCP server.

api_key.title: ForthClear MCP API key (optional)
api_key.description: Leave empty to browse the catalog. Needed for seller tools, order status, disputes and quick buy. Buyers generate one at https://app.forthclear.io/settings, sellers at https://app.forthclear.io/seller/settings.
